claim: For an alarm with a period of one minute or longer, CloudWatch evaluates the alarm every minute, using the window of time defined by the Period and Evaluation Periods; the exception is when the number of evaluation periods multiplied by the length of each evaluation period exceeds one day, in which case the alarm is evaluated once per hour.

qualifiers.scope: per metric alarm, period of one minute or longer
qualifiers.condition: not when evaluation periods x period exceeds one day (then once per hour)

evidence.quote: For any period of one minute or longer, an alarm is evaluated every minute and the evaluation is based on the window of time defined by the **Period** and **Evaluation Periods**.
If the number of evaluation periods multiplied by the length of each evaluation period exceeds one day, the alarm is evaluated once per hour.
